subject: general
question: The study of birds is called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ornithology.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****

__
 
• **Ornithology**

 
 
• **The scientific study of birds is known as Ornithology. **

 
 
• **Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
 
 
• It evolved in Europe during the late **16th century.**
 
• Ornithologists are people who study the **behavior, physiology, and conservation of birds and bird habitats.**
 
• **Dr.Salim Ali** (1896–1987) is known as **the Father of Indian Ornithology.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 Ophthalmology is the study of the anatomy, physiology, and diseases of the eye.
